$comment: Named verifier groups for the focused database gate (QAN-INF-05).
A selector is a NAME, never a command. The runner resolves it here, refuses any
path that is not database/verify-<slug>.mjs, and spawns node with that path as an
argument - no shell is involved at any point, so nothing in this file and nothing
a workflow input can say is ever interpreted as shell.
A group is convenience, not a requirement: any single verifier can be selected
generically as migration-NNNN without appearing here, so a new migration needs no
edit to this file, to the runner or to the workflow.
Groups are additive. Adding one may not change what an existing one means.
